dedupe_keys.name: harmonized and open energy dataset for modeling a highly renewable brazilian power system

description: This data set assembles harmonised open data for modelling a highly renewable Brazilian power system. It contains geospatial data for Brazil, an aggregated grid network topology, variable renewable potentials with profiles and installable capacity, installable biomass thermal capacity, hydropower plant inflows, existing and planned generators with capacities, electricity load profiles and scenarios of sectoral energy demand. It was produced by Ying Deng, Karl-Kien Cao and co-authors, and published in the DLR Zenodo community alongside a data descriptor paper, with the processing code on GitLab, so that others can reproduce and extend Brazilian energy system models. Coverage is Brazil at the level of the aggregated network regions. The data are a ZIP of about 73 MB on Zenodo (version 0.2, revised December 2022) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the grid is aggregated, not a full transmission model, and the data have not been updated since 2022. Simulation uses are capacity expansion planning, optimisation and network flow studies of the Brazilian power system with high renewable shares.
